name: llm-rag-retrieval-internals
description: Use when the user asks to build a RAG pipeline over documentation, tune HNSW (M, efSearch) or IVF-PQ (nprobe), hybrid dense + BM25 search, reciprocal rank fusion, cross-encoder reranking, Self-RAG or DSPy. Produces index choice and parameters, a hybrid+rerank pipeline and recall evals. Not for query rewriting and RAG prompts (use prompt-rag-query-design).
